Lifecycle Governance Section 82C ITA 1967 Compliance
Issuers or buyers can cancel/reject within 72h. Past 72h, the cancel API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request; transactions can only be adjusted via linked Credit Note (02).
All Credit Notes (02), Debit Notes (03), and Refund Notes (04) must embed the verified 36-character UUID of the original cleared invoice.
Adjustments cannot be issued against cancelled or rejected documents; only Valid cleared documents permit linked notes.
